notes.title: Delay in Updates
notes.content: [p][b]Hey everyone,[/b][/p][p]I wanted to give you all a quick update on why there haven't been many updates to [i]CnC[/i] recently.[/p][p]I've been pretty busy with school and some personal matters, so development had to slow down a bit. That said, as summer approaches, I'm planning to take some time to really figure out the direction I want to take with the [b]Item Upgrade System[/b]. Right now, I’m not fully satisfied with how it works, and I want to make sure it feels just right.[/p][p]It might be a little while before the next update drops, but when it does, it’ll be a solid one—hopefully with some meaningful improvements and minimal bugs thanks to thorough testing.[/p][p]Thanks so much for your patience and support![/p][p]- LuckyGp[/p]

notes.title: Early Access - Update 0.2
notes.content:
[h1]Update 0.5[/h1]

[h3]Hey everyone! I'm back with a fresh coat of paint.
While I've been away studying, I found some spare moments to revisit Craft & Conquer. I've been working on reimagining the game—shifting it more toward an idle game experience than before.

My goal this time around is to make the base game rock-solid, with no major issues like lost saves or random mishaps. It should be a stable, polished foundation for everything that comes next. I hope xD I will be working on New Updates more often from now on! Get excited![/h3]

*Please Report Any Bugs <3

I wont tell you what's new or Changed here! Just try it out as a whole new thing :)

[h2]Plans For the Upcoming Patch.[/h2]

- First Thing I want to Work on is Expanding RPG! (Items, Zones, Bonuses & Item Crafting/Upgrading System)
- Item Set Bonuses (or something similar).
- New Dungeons
- More Art Updates.

notes.title: Changes/Plans for the Future
notes.content:
Thank You for Playing Craft & Conquer in Early Access!

Hello everyone,

First and foremost, I want to thank you all for playing Craft & Conquer during its Early Access phase. Your support and feedback have been invaluable.

As many of you know, I’m a programming student, and I originally created this game as a way to learn—not just about coding, but also about game development as a whole, including community engagement. Since launching the game, I’ve learned a great deal about what it takes to create a compelling experience, and I truly appreciate all the insights and suggestions you've shared.

With that in mind, I’ve decided to rebrand Craft & Conquer. While the core of the game will remain the same, I plan to restructure certain aspects and potentially revamp the introduction to create a stronger foundation. I believe this is the best step forward for the project.

This process may take some time, as I currently have a lot on my plate and a busy schedule. However, I’m committed to improving the game whenever I can. During this period, I also aim to address many of the existing issues to enhance the overall experience.

Thank you for your patience and continued support—I’m excited about what’s ahead!

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, I appreciate your feedback.

— LuckyGp

notes.title: Early Access - Update 0.1
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone, Thank you for playing my game and thank you for all your help with bugs and ideas.[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ys0ryBi.png[/img]
[list] 
[*] Added A Stat Point Reset Button. (Free For now)
[*] Added a new Dungeon (Numerinos).

[list]
[*] Separated Auto & Manual Saves, and added an indicator to know which save is newer.
[*] Dungeon Drop Rebalance (Drop Rate for Attack is now Changed from 10% to 5%).
[*] Reworked RPG Stats ( Stats are now Future Proof with separated Values).
[*] RPG Xp Rebalance (XpUntilLevel = XpNeededForLevelPreviously * PlayerLevel^1.2 to * PlayerLevel^0,5)
[*] Dungeons are now 2x Slower.
[*] Huan The One is now The Numerinos Boss.
[*] Reduced Boss Spawn rate. (You will be able to increase it Next Patch) ;)

[*] Other Small Changes.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/V1bz1wA.png[/img]
[list] 
[*] Fixed Garbage Slot would not remove Items Stats when Deleting items straight from Equipped Items.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could Keep Firing Troops even after reaching 0.
[*] Fixed a bug where Dungeons would still run even if there was not enough food.
[*] Better Backward Compatibility When Loading After An Update.
[*] Other Smaller Bugs.
[/list]

[h2]Notes[/h2]

This update focuses primarily on addressing bugs and improving the overall experience. While I initially planned to introduce the Kingdom feature in this patch, I've decided to take more time to refine its direction and ensure it fits seamlessly into the game.

Looking ahead, the next update will be packed with exciting new content, especially for RPG. During the development of this update, I also came up with an exciting idea that will shape the overall direction of the game, and I can’t wait to share it with you!

The next update is scheduled for release by January 19th at the latest—stay tuned!

[b]There might be a small Update in the middle of the week that would introduce Auto Crafting and other Quality of life things.[/b]

notes.title: Small Update from The Dev
notes.content:
I’m currently working on the first update following our Early Access release, and after reviewing your feedback, I’ve realized there are several issues that need fixing. Rest assured, I will address them! However, there may come a time in the future when the original players (you!) might need to start a new save (a full reset for everyone).

If that happens, don’t worry! Everyone who played before the reset will receive a special reward. :)

For now, feel free to have fun and experiment with any exploits or bugs you find—but please let me know about them so I can address them!

I’m here to answer all your questions. Thank you for your support!
